title: Portuguese Miso Fondue
description: A unique fusion of Portuguese and Japanese flavors in a delicious and easy-to-make fondue. Perfect for a fun dinner party or a cozy night in.
instructions: Heat the shredded cheese in a saucepan over medium heat until melted and smooth.
Add the miso paste and stir until well combined.
Cut the burrata cheese into small pieces and add to the cheese mixture.
Continue heating until the cheese is melted and creamy.
Transfer the fondue to a fondue pot or a small ceramic bowl.
Serve with cubed bread and garnish with chopped parsley.
Dip bread into the fondue until coated, then enjoy!
Repeat the process until all bread is coated and fondue is gone.
Serve immediately and enjoy with a fun dinner party or cozy night in.
Optional: Add a splash of wine or beer to the fondue for added flavor.
